_comment: Regauntless BACKGROUNDS — the third character-creation grant source (Race/Class/Background; see character-creation.md). HOUSE-AUTHORED content: NOT transcribed from any SRD (there is no backgrounds system in SRD 3.5; 5e's are mostly closed WotC content). These use familiar archetype TROPES (pirate, army-brat, medic, cultist) as inspiration but the MECHANICS and wording are our own, built on our own primitives (skills.json / feats.json / the +-5 circumstance pile in combat.md). Keeps the project license-clean (OGL 3.5 + original house content, no closed 5e material). A background grants: grantedFeats (perks AND drawbacks — disadvantages = negative feats), skillsMadeNative (reclassify a skill to class-skill/1pt-per-rank + a starting rank), and flavor. Backgrounds are USUALLY perk+drawback (teeth), but may be pure-upside (Medical). The 'Backgrounds pattern' (seed rank + reclassify-to-native) is reusable for any skill.

_schema.name: string
_schema.grantedFeats: [{feat: key -> feats.json, kind: perk|drawback, houseAuthored: bool, effect: short plain-language effect}]
_schema.skillsMadeNative: [{skill: key -> skills.json, startingRank: int, note}] — reclassify to native (1pt/rank) for this char + seed rank (character-creation.md Backgrounds pattern)

backgrounds.name: Pirate
backgrounds.flavor: Loot first, apologize never. Your mother would be ashamed; your coin purse is thrilled. Polite society remains an unsolved problem.

grantedFeats.effect: -5 circumstance (the 3.5 'disadvantage' = flat -5, combat.md) on social interactions.

skillsMadeNative.note: rigging & rope — Climb becomes class-native (1pt/rank) + start at 1
sea legs — Swim native + start at 1

backgrounds.note: Perk+drawback package with teeth: loot bonus bought with social penalty. Greedy/Unsavory are house feats (need entries in feats.json when the feat-authoring pass happens). Social -5 lives in the circumstance pile (only bites IF a social-check context exists; combat.md).

backgrounds.name: Army Brat
backgrounds.flavor: Weaned on reveille and gun oil. Other kids got bedtime stories; you got a field manual and a weapon that was always leaning in the corner. Loud noises are just Tuesday.

grantedFeats.effect: SRD feat (feats.json). Granted for ONE chosen martial weapon (the one that was always around the house) — weapon familiarity from the upbringing, not professional training.
+5 circumstance to resist FEAR / morale-break (grew up unfazed by the sounds of a war camp).

skillsMadeNative.note: camp life — Survival native + start at 1 (bivouac skills, not battlefield command)

backgrounds.note: Reframed from 'Soldier' (which is a PROFESSION = the Fighter class, not an origin). A background is WHERE YOU CAME FROM, not what you're trained as. Army Brat = military UPBRINGING: weapon familiarity + unshakability + camp skills, absorbed as a kid. Keeps the clean line: class = trained-as, background = came-from. Steady is a house feat (fear-resist +5). No drawback (usually-paired-not-required).

backgrounds.name: Medical
backgrounds.flavor: You know where the bits go and roughly how to keep them there. 'Hold still — this'll only hurt if I did it wrong.' Somebody on this crew has to, and congratulations, it's you.

skillsMadeNative.note: THE medic enabler (character-creation.md / combat-model.md revive): Heal becomes class-native (1pt/rank, not cross-class 2x) + start at 1 -> the First-Aid revive button lights up from level 1.

backgrounds.note: The canonical pure-upside background (character-creation.md example). Its whole value = cheap Heal scaling + a starting rank, making ANY class a viable field medic. No drawback. This is what makes 'who's the medic' a build choice.

backgrounds.name: Raised in a Cult
backgrounds.flavor: You left the compound; the compound didn't entirely leave you. You can still channel a little of... whatever that was. Try not to think too hard about the chanting.

grantedFeats.effect: Grants divine casting at the DABBLER envelope (character-creation.md: a reduced caster progression, ~half slots / low caster level / capped tier) — NOT full cleric casting. Proof a background can grant a class feature.
-5 circumstance on WILL saves vs effects that play on faith/fear/charm-of-conviction (true-believer blind spot). (Tunable; placeholder drawback.)

skillsMadeNative.note: liturgical focus — Concentration native + start at 1 (helps the dabbler casting)

backgrounds.note: The 'capability from a non-class source' proof case (character-creation.md: Warrior-raised-in-a-cult can cast). Divine Casting is a house-granted feat carrying the DABBLER caster envelope (defer the actual progression numbers to the caster layer). Perk+drawback: power bought with a will-save blind spot. Skips a separate 'Acolyte' background — this IS that trope, better-named.
